decisions: WorkBridge is a product in deployment, not a hackathon deliverable; the submission is history (tag final-24h, git history).

v1 covers all of Panama and a broader occupation taxonomy than the original three families.

v1 notifications use transactional email driven by the SQL outbox; no SMS or WhatsApp.
Seven production blockers are required in order: persistence, national transfer data, real credential verification, bias auditor on the web path, email, paid models, privacy and retention.
One root CONTEXT.md replaces the eight-context map; no per-package context until a package earns a seam.
Hackathon artifacts are deleted from the tree, not archived in it; git history and the final-24h tag preserve them.
Product documentation is written in Spanish; governance documents remain in English.
Fairness claims are only valid where the counterfactual auditor actually runs.
